db = dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ":memory:")
dbExecute(db, "PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
dbExecute(db, "CREATE TABLE airlines (carrier TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
dbExecute(db, "CREATE TABLE airports (faa TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
dbExecute(db, "CREATE TABLE planes (tailnum TEXT PRIMARY KEY, manufacturer TEXT, model TEXT, seats INTEGER)")
dbExecute(db, "CREATE TABLE flights (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  carrier TEXT REFERENCES airlines (carrier), tailnum TEXT REFERENCES planes (tailnum),
  origin TEXT REFERENCES airports (faa), dest TEXT REFERENCES airports (faa), dep_delay INTEGER)")
dbWriteTable(db, "airlines", airlines, append = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(db, "airports", airports, append = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(db, "planes", planes, append = TRUE)
dbWriteTable(db, "flights", flights, append = TRUE)

changed = 0
added = 0

# rebuild the wide table for a dashboard
wide = tbl(db, "flights") %>%
  left_join(tbl(db, "airlines") %>% rename(airline = name), by = "carrier") %>%
  left_join(tbl(db, "planes"), by = "tailnum") %>%
  collect()
code.sql:
-- Postgres enforces REFERENCES always; SQLite only with PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
CREATE TABLE airlines (carrier TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
CREATE TABLE flights (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  carrier TEXT REFERENCES airlines (carrier),
  tailnum TEXT REFERENCES planes (tailnum),
  origin TEXT REFERENCES airports (faa),
  dest TEXT REFERENCES airports (faa),
  dep_delay INTEGER);

-- the join that rebuilds the wide table
SELECT f.*, a.name AS airline, p.manufacturer, p.model, p.seats
FROM flights f
LEFT JOIN airlines a ON a.carrier = f.carrier
LEFT JOIN planes p ON p.tailnum = f.tailnum;
